blocks.text: Suno 始于一个简单的信念：每个人都有创造力。有了合适的工具，人们就能做出原创作品，感受把想法变成现实的快乐。在 Suno 上，我们每天都能看到这样的例子：有人重新演绎自己高中乐队的歌曲，有人把一段语音备忘录变成婚礼歌曲。

原创为本，设计使然

blocks.text: 今年早些时候，我们分享了负责任地构建音乐未来的原则。我们的目标是打造全球最好的创意娱乐平台，以拓展艺术家、版权方和整个音乐生态的可能性。从一开始，我们就刻意把 Suno 设计成支持原创创作，并设置防护措施，防止我们的工具被用于不符合我们原则的用途。

blocks.text: Visuals 也以同样的方式构建，在音乐方面已有的防护之外，还增加了额外的保障措施，保护艺术家免遭其肖像或作品被未经授权使用。

inlines.text: Visuals 也以同样的方式构建，在音乐方面已有的防护之外，还增加了额外的保障措施，保护艺术家免遭其肖像或作品被未经授权使用。
我们采用了一套新的文本和视觉过滤器，旨在阻止那些试图使用或生成特定艺术家、公众人物、受版权保护作品和 IP 的视觉形象的上传和提示词。这意味着在其他视频平台上有效的提示词，在 Suno 上可能无效，而这是有意为之。
随后，我们用这些相同的过滤器以及额外的第三方工具，检查生成的视频或图像是否违反我们的社区准则——该准则禁止范围广泛的有害内容。这一步在 Visual 展示给用户之前完成，以便我们尽早发现令人担忧的内容。
我们正在继续与 Audible Magic、ACRCloud
和 Musixmatch 合作，拦截包含受版权保护音频的上传内容。
在视觉内容分享到平台之外前，我们会用标注工具为其添加嵌入式水印。

blocks.text: 在采取这些保护措施的同时，我们也在平台内开展用户教育。Suno 用户首次尝试上传视频或图片用于视觉内容时，我们会提醒他们该工具用于原创创作，并请他们确认自己拥有所用文件的相关权利。

Original Creation, By Design

blocks.text: Earlier this year we shared our principles for building the future of music responsibly. Our goal is to build the world’s best platform for creative entertainment, in ways that expand possibilities for artists, rightsholders and the larger music ecosystem. From the beginning, we deliberately designed Suno to enable original creation, with guardrails to keep our tools from being used in ways that don’t conform to our principles.

principles

guardrails

blocks.text: We’ve built Visuals the same way, with additional safeguards to protect artists from unauthorized use of their likenesses or works, on top of the ones we already have in place for music.

inlines.text: We’ve built Visuals the same way, with additional safeguards to protect artists from unauthorized use of their likenesses or works, on top of the ones we already have in place for music.

We’ve adopted a suite of new text and visual filters intended to block uploads and prompts that try to use or create visual representations of specific artists, public figures, copyrighted works and IP. This means that prompts that work on other video platforms may not work on Suno and that’s by design.

We then use these same filters and additional third-party tools to check generated videos or images for violations of our Community Guidelines, which prohibit a comprehensive range of harmful content. This step happens before the Visual is shown to the user, so we can catch concerning content early.
We are continuing our work with Audible Magic, ACRCloud
and Musixmatch to block uploads that contain copyrighted audio.
We will use our labeling tools to apply embedded watermarks to Visuals before they can be shared off-platform.

blocks.text: We are pairing these protections with in-platform user education. The first time a Suno user tries to upload a video or image to use with Visuals, we remind them the tool is for original creation, and to confirm they have the rights to any file they are trying to use.

blocks.text: If we detect misuse of our products or it is reported to us, our Trust and Safety team investigates and takes action, which could include removing the content, restricting the account or – in the most severe cases – terminating it completely.
